steps.caption: Open the Lumen Harbour Tech lease from Leases.
Obligations: each one shows the category, the clause text, the responsible party, the deadline, the status and the source page.
They were read from the deed: insurance, structural repairs, no sub-letting, restoring the premises. Unclear responsibility is shown as unclear.
Mark one Done with the evidence — for example the insurance policy number.
Add an obligation by hand: category, what must be done, who is responsible and the deadline.
Now open the Obligations tab: every lease's obligations in one tracker.
Source-linked summaries — not legal advice. Filter by status and by party: tenant, landlord, shared or unclear.
The list shows the open tenant obligations, with the lease each belongs to.
